pedagogical_summary.one_sentence: The Transformer replaces recurrent and convolutional layers in sequence transduction with pure attention mechanisms, enabling parallelization and achieving state-of-the-art translation performance with reduced training time.
pedagogical_summary.problem: Recurrent and convolutional neural networks in sequence transduction suffer from sequential computation bottlenecks, limiting parallelization and scalability, especially for long sequences and long-range dependencies.
pedagogical_summary.solution: A novel architecture called the Transformer uses stacked self-attention and position-wise feed-forward layers, eliminating recurrence and convolutions while enabling constant-time path lengths and full parallelization.
